log_level.description: Logging verbosity: debug, info, warning, or error.

backends.description: List of backend plugins to enable (e.g., 'mpris', 'renderer', 'rest', 'upnp').

items.description: Name of a dleyna-server backend module.

http_address.description: Network interface to bind the HTTP server to (e.g., '127.0.0.1', '0.0.0.0').

http_port.description: TCP port for the HTTP API and renderer web UI.

service_hostname.description: Override hostname used in mDNS/SRVC discovery (e.g., 'my-renderer.local').

dbus_interfaces.description: List of D-Bus interfaces to whitelist for access (leave empty to allow all).

environment.description: Extra environment variables passed to backend subprocesses.

trusted_subnets.description: List of trusted IP subnets (CIDR notation) allowed unauthenticated access.

ssl_cert_path.description: Absolute path to TLS certificate file (required for HTTPS).

ssl_key_path.description: Absolute path to TLS private key file (required for HTTPS).
